description: Summary figure (final): CACUL1 architecture, AlphaFold confidence, Foldseek coverage
code:
import json, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
iface=json.load(open('interface_residues.json'))
plddt=pd.read_csv('cacul1_plddt_per_residue.csv', index_col=0)['pLDDT']
df=pd.read_csv('foldseek_pdb100_hits.csv')

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(12.5,10))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,1,height_ratios=[1.3,0.85,1.1],hspace=0.6)
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
tracks=[('CUL1 (Q13616)',776,[(21,518,'#90cdf4'),(539,658,'#f6ad55'),(706,766,'#fc8181')]),
        ('CUL3 (Q13618)',768,[(34,484,'#90cdf4'),(507,665,'#f6ad55'),(698,760,'#fc8181')]),
        ('CACUL1 (Q86Y37)',369,[(137,293,'#90cdf4')])]
for i,(name,L,feats) in enumerate(tracks):
    y=2-i
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0,y-0.16),L,0.32,fc='#e2e8f0',ec='#718096',lw=0.8))
    for a,b,c in feats: ax.add_patch(Rectangle((a,y-0.16),b-a,0.32,fc=c,ec='#2d3748',lw=0.6))
    ax.text(-20,y,name,ha='right',va='center',fontsize=9.5)
    ax.text(L+12,y,f'{L} aa',va='center',fontsize=8,color='#4a5568')
ax.text(270,2.62,'cullin repeats PF00888',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.text(598,2.90,'a+b domain PF26557',ha='center',fontsize=8,color='#b7791f')
ax.text(736,2.76,'neddylation WHB PF10557',ha='center',fontsize=8,color='#c53030')
for p,_ in iface['CUL1_RBX1_contacts']: ax.plot([p],[2.22],marker='|',color='#2b6cb0',ms=5,mew=0.9)
ax.text(615,2.34,'62 RBX1-contact residues (1LDJ)',fontsize=8,color='#2b6cb0',ha='center')
ax.plot([720],[1.78],marker='v',color='#c53030',ms=7); ax.text(735,1.60,'K720 NEDD8',fontsize=8,color='#c53030',ha='left')
ax.plot([712],[0.78],marker='v',color='#c53030',ms=7); ax.text(727,0.60,'K712 NEDD8',fontsize=8,color='#c53030',ha='left')
for p,_ in iface['CUL3_BTB_contacts']: ax.plot([p],[1.22],marker='|',color='#2f855a',ms=5,mew=0.9)
ax.text(150,1.36,'23 BTB-adaptor contacts (4HXI)',fontsize=8,color='#2f855a')
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((131,-0.16),107,0.32,fc='none',ec='#2f855a',lw=1.6,ls='--'))
ax.annotate('CACUL1 131-237 superposes on CUL3 27-132\n(100 CA pairs, RMSD 1.53 A, 25% identity)',
            xy=(185,-0.19),xytext=(420,-0.72),fontsize=8,color='#2f855a',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->',color='#2f855a',lw=0.9))
ax.set_xlim(-180,920); ax.set_ylim(-1.0,3.05); ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel('residue')
for s in ['top','right','left']: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
ax.set_title('A  CACUL1 carries one cullin repeat and none of the catalytic scaffold modules',loc='left',fontsize=11)

ax2=fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
ax2.plot(plddt.index,plddt.values,lw=1.1,color='#2b6cb0')
ax2.axhline(70,ls=':',color='#718096',lw=0.9); ax2.axvspan(137,293,color='#90cdf4',alpha=0.35)
ax2.text(215,14,'PF00888 cullin repeat, mean pLDDT 95.4',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax2.text(63,14,'1-130 disordered\nmean pLDDT 42.4',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax2.set_xlim(1,369); ax2.set_ylim(0,105); ax2.set_ylabel('pLDDT'); ax2.set_xlabel('CACUL1 residue')
ax2.set_title('B  AlphaFold AF-Q86Y37-F1 v6: the only confidently folded module is the single cullin repeat',loc='left',fontsize=11)
for s in ['top','right']: ax2.spines[s].set_visible(False)

ax3=fig.add_subplot(gs[2])
cul=df[(df.dbLen>600)&(df['eval']<0.5)].copy()
cul['short']=cul.target.str.split('-assembly').str[0].str.upper()+' '+cul.target.str.extract(r'cif\.gz_(\S+)')[0]
cul=cul.sort_values('eval').head(20).iloc[::-1]
for i,(_,r) in enumerate(cul.iterrows()):
    ax3.plot([1,r.dbLen],[i,i],color='#cbd5e0',lw=4,solid_capstyle='butt')
    ax3.plot([r.dbStartPos,r.dbEndPos],[i,i],color='#2b6cb0',lw=4,solid_capstyle='butt')
ax3.set_yticks(range(len(cul))); ax3.set_yticklabels(cul.short,fontsize=6.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('residue position in the cullin chain of the PDB entry'); ax3.set_ylim(-1.2,len(cul)+1.5)
ax3.set_title('C  Foldseek of the CACUL1 model vs PDB100: alignment to cullins (blue) stops at residue 247 or earlier in every case',loc='left',fontsize=11)
ax3.axvline(250,ls='--',color='#c53030',lw=1)
ax3.text(265,len(cul)-3.2,'no match beyond ~250:\nno a+b domain, no RBX1 site,\nno neddylation WHB',fontsize=8,color='#c53030')
for s in ['top','right']: ax3.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.show()
